summary: Baseline-only checkpoint for the finite-module prime-filtration strand of R03.3. Both the actual filtration and its exact-sequence induction principle already exist in the pinned Mathlib. They are recorded as baseline references, not duplicated as new nodes. This settles the generic algebra requested by AutomorphicBundles B5, not its geometric prime-quotient case. The other targets of the eight-stage part remain unblueprinted here; the existing integrated decomposition is preserved separately and is not certified or replaced by this checkpoint.

declarations.provides: For submodules N1,N2 of an R-module over a commutative ring, N1 <= N2 together with a prime ideal p and an R-linear equivalence from N2/(N1 restricted to N2) to R/p. The equivalence is recorded by Nonempty; the prime is a PrimeSpectrum point.
declarations.checked: Definition, ambient ring/module universes and adjacent characterization proof read at the pinned commit on 2026-09-26; file blob 8981a4233c39016cfd51e882d7da6d90c368dec9.

declarations.provides: A prime cyclic subquotient is equivalent to adjoining a vector x to N1 whose image in M/N1 has prime annihilator. The formula for the larger submodule is N1 plus the span of x.
declarations.checked: Both directions read at the pinned commit: the forward direction lifts the class of 1; the reverse constructs the quotient linear equivalence. File blob 8981a4233c39016cfd51e882d7da6d90c368dec9.

declarations.provides: For any commutative Noetherian ring R and finite R-module M, a RelSeries of actual submodules from bottom to top whose successive quotients are R/p. No local, complete, Dedekind, finite-length or freeness assumption is present.
declarations.checked: Full statement and proof by ascending-chain induction, associated primes of nonzero quotients, and adjoining a cyclic subquotient read at the pinned commit. The declaration has Stacks tag 00L0.

declarations.provides: An induction principle for a property of finite R-modules in a fixed module universe: prove the subsingleton case, every module linearly equivalent to R/p, and preservation across a short exact sequence specified by an injective first map, surjective second map and Function.Exact. It concludes the property for every finite module.
declarations.checked: Full dependent signature and proof read at the pinned commit, including transport through linear equivalences, the RelSeries induction, submoduleOfEquivOfLe and exact_subtype_mkQ. The parameter is the Module.Finite proof, not a chosen filtration.

declarations.provides: The associated-prime set of a finite module over a commutative Noetherian ring is finite. Its proof is an existing concrete application of the preceding induction principle.
declarations.checked: Statement and all three induction cases read at the pinned commit. The declaration has Stacks tag 00LC. This was also a presence lead in the accepted AUDIT-17 R03.3 record.

baselineCoverage.target: Generic finite prime filtration and exact-sequence devissage
baselineCoverage.consumerContract: Use the existing induction with the property that the constructed Fourier-Jacobi map is injective. The consumer must still prove the zero case, transport its prime-quotient case through linear equivalences by naturality, and prove its nonsplit extension step. No generic prime-filtration request to R03.3 is necessary.
